AlertModal.reason: Created by a service (ModalService). Can be rebuilt on cds-modal, but it is not a tag.

BaseIconButton.reason: base class (no selector); its inputs are folded into subclasses

BaseNotification.reason: base class (no selector); its inputs are folded into subclasses

BaseTabHeader.reason: base class (no selector); its inputs are folded into subclasses

Dialog.reason: Removed in v7: internal. Base popover dialog used by OverflowMenu. Replaced by cds-popover / cds-overflow-menu-body.

DropdownList.reason: Model-driven list (ListItem[]). Web components use cds-dropdown-item / cds-multi-select-item children.

HeaderGlobal.reason: Plain layout container. The web component header has no global-bar element.

IconTab.reason: No icon-only tab element. cds-tab takes an icon in its default slot; check cds-tabs type="icon" support.

Label.reason: Wraps any projected input. Each web component input renders its own label (label-text slot).

OverflowMenuCustomPane.reason: Free-form pane. The closest is cds-overflow-menu-body with custom children.

Placeholder.reason: Angular-only. Hosts dynamically created components (modal / dialog services).

TabHeaderGroup.reason: No grouped tab header in web components.

TabHeaderGroupVertical.reason: No grouped tab header in web components.

TableHeaderDecorator.reason: Use the decorator / ai-label slot on the cell.

TabsVerticalGrouped.reason: No grouped vertical tabs in web components.

AbstractDropdownView.reason: Removed in v7: internal. Abstract base class for DropdownList.

AspectRatioDirective.reason: No aspect-ratio element in web components. CSS utility.

BaseModal.reason: Removed in v7 with the modal rewrite. Custom modals extend it today (ModalService), so the rewrite needs a replacement for service-created modals.

DialogDirective.reason: Removed in v7: internal. Base dialog directive. Replaced by cds-popover.

ExpandedRowHover.reason: Removed in v7: internal. Hover state is inside cds-table-expanded-row.

RowDirective.reason: Flexbox grid only. The web components implement CSS Grid only (cds-grid / cds-column); the flexbox grid exists only as @carbon/styles classes. Kept as an Angular-only class directive.
RowDirective.keep: Flexbox grid only: keep the class directive.

ScrollableList.reason: Removed in v7: internal. Behaviour is inside the web component listbox.

TabHeader.reason: Removed in v7: internal. cds-tab is the header. Panels are separate elements linked by id.

TabHeaderBase.reason: base class (no selector); its inputs are folded into subclasses

TableHeadCellLabel.reason: Removed in v7: internal. cds-table-header-cell text is its default slot.

ThemeDirective.reason: No theme element in web components. Use the @carbon/styles theme classes or cds-layer.
